name: @tyroneross/spectra
description: AI-native UI automation across web, macOS, iOS, and watchOS with plugin, MCP server, and standalone CLI surfaces.

scripts.build:native: bash scripts/build-swift-helper.sh "$HOME/.spectra/bin/spectra-native" native/swift/*.swift -framework Foundation -framework ApplicationServices -framework AppKit -framework CoreGraphics -framework Vision -framework ScreenCaptureKit -framework AVFoundation -framework CoreMedia -framework CoreVideo
scripts.build:composite: bash scripts/build-swift-helper.sh "$HOME/.spectra/bin/spectra-composite-capture" -parse-as-library native/swift/composite-capture/*.swift -framework Foundation -framework ScreenCaptureKit -framework AVFoundation -framework CoreMedia -framework CoreVideo -framework CoreGraphics -framework AppKit && bash scripts/build-swift-helper.sh "$HOME/.spectra/bin/spectra-screen-recording-preflight" native/swift/screen-recording-preflight/*.swift -framework Foundation -framework CoreGraphics
scripts.build:cursor-sampler: bash scripts/build-swift-helper.sh "$HOME/.spectra/bin/spectra-cursor-sampler" native/swift/cursor-sampler/*.swift -framework Foundation -framework ApplicationServices -framework AppKit -framework CoreGraphics
scripts.build:text-render: bash scripts/build-swift-helper.sh "$HOME/.spectra/bin/spectra-text-render" native/swift/text-render/*.swift -framework Foundation -framework CoreGraphics -framework CoreText -framework CoreImage -framework ImageIO -framework UniformTypeIdentifiers
scripts.build:window-bounds: bash scripts/build-swift-helper.sh "$HOME/.spectra/bin/spectra-window-bounds" native/swift/window-bounds/*.swift -framework Foundation -framework AppKit -framework CoreGraphics
